scientific_integrity: Exact labeled-subset classification and count are supported by the full argument and a standalone bitmask verifier. The 2017 and 2021 results provide definitions and a general necessary condition, not the claimed complete Cartesian-rook characterization.
scientific_limitations: Only finite rook graphs with two complete factors of orders at least two; no higher Cartesian powers or singleton factors.
Finite exhaustive checks and construction tests corroborate but do not prove the all-parameter theorem.
Equivalence to a theorem outside retrieved and inspected mathematical literature remains a bibliographic possibility.
Independent scientific review has not been performed.
title: Arithmetic rigidity and exact census of open-independent open-locating-dominating sets in rook graphs
